context: M1 o3. Broadway & W 31st St, under a wholesaler's dark awning. One untimed choice.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Here it is. People still need to pay. Cops can't take it. Not by hand. Not now.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: So we need a civilian. Somebody who knows every door. Somebody nobody watches.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: A courier. Two hundred a week, cash. You'd be doing the old crowd a favor.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: And kid? Your hotel just got sold. Ask who's buying. Then call me.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: No. I stopped carrying for you when I stopped carrying a gun.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: You never stopped, kid. You just stopped getting paid.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Not tonight, Carl. I got a shift.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Sure. Nights are long. Think about it in the elevator.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Read the notice. Lawyers love a notice. Then think about my offer.

lines.speaker: char.carl_mayhew
lines.text: Go on. Your old men are waiting. I'll find you.
